description: Date picker with a trigger button, dropdown calendar popup, today shortcut, clear button, and min/max date constraints. Supports custom date format and label.

parameters.name: LabelTrailing
parameters.description: Content rendered at the end of the label row (a hint chip). Rendered only while set; without it the label markup is unchanged.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Focusable trigger that does not open on click/Enter/Alt+Down, hides the clear button, does not render the calendar icon, and announces the lock as aria-disabled="true" with aria-haspopup="false" and no aria-expanded (aria-readonly is not a supported attribute on role=button); root carries tm-date-picker--readonly and the trigger surface reads like the other read-only inputs (--tm-bg-surface-secondary, no disabled colours, no fade). The tab stop stays. Consumer aria-* attributes passed through AdditionalAttributes still win.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: Extra ids joined onto the trigger aria-describedby together with the surrounding TmFormField cascade.

parameters.name: AllowTypedDate
parameters.description: When true (default false) renders a CurrentCulture short-date text field (`.tm-date-picker-typed`). A failed parse marks the picker invalid and keeps Value. The field shares the trigger aria-describedby; aria-labelledby names it from Label, with aria-label only as the no-label fallback.

examples.title: Date picker with constraints and custom format
examples.code:
<TmDatePicker @bind-Value="selectedDate"
              Label="Start date"
              DateFormat="yyyy-MM-dd"
              MinDate="@(new DateOnly(2026, 1, 1))"
              MaxDate="@(new DateOnly(2026, 12, 31))"
              Required="true" />
